data.text: Before we choose, I suggest we each catch 10 tons this month. That leaves 50, so next month’s stock returns to 100 under either outcome: natural replenishment or doubling. We’d each earn $10,000 a month without depleting the lake if we stick to that plan. Catching more could pay more today, but risks smaller future stocks—and leaving fewer than 5 tons means collapse. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone keeps the agreement. John, would you agree to 10 tons each?
